requirements.COMP-001: Installed opencode2 starts/reuses its authenticated daemon and opens the native TUI without manual serve, browser or session setup.
requirements.COMP-002: Owned Rust bridge to the pinned OpenTUI Zig renderer, with required TypeScript orchestration reimplemented in Rust and no JS runtime in native mode.
requirements.COMP-003: Every original requirement, accepted task, OpenCode V2 behavior, compatibility surface and observed upstream delta is reconciled and verified.
requirements.COMP-004: Opt-in self-hosted account/device gateway published through named Cloudflare Tunnel; PCs connect outbound with explicit pairing and revocation.
requirements.COMP-005: Real installed iOS and Android clients control authorized PC workspaces, sessions, tabs, prompts, tools and approvals.
requirements.COMP-006: One main agent targets 20 rolling native workers with safe ownership, bounded resources, independent verification and serialized integration.
requirements.COMP-007: Completion requires installed-product, platform, source-parity and device evidence on the exact integrated release revision.

contract.ownership: Paths are proposed parent-slice locks, not multi-file worker grants. Reconcile actual modules, prewire shared contracts, then delegate one-file children under AGENTS.md. Only the integrator edits shared routes, schemas, migrations, Cargo manifests and lockfiles.
contract.verticalSlice: Each journey includes actual UI or CLI entrypoint, authenticated service, authorization, persistence, events, failure presentation and packaging as applicable. A helper, source file, fake success or disconnected test does not satisfy it.
contract.tests: T01..T05 are minimum explicit scenarios. Independent test author establishes executable behavioral RED, freezes test and command hashes, implementer supplies GREEN, independent verifier reruns after integration. Zero discovered tests, compile failure as RED and worker-edited tests are invalid.
contract.fixtures: Use disposable homes/workspaces and scripted external provider responses. The actual app, renderer, permission broker, database and tools must run. Never modify real OpenCode history or use user secrets as fixtures.
contract.resources: Keep queues, buffers, output, retries and retention bounded. Measure whole-process-tree memory. Preserve 8 GiB host budget, 2 GiB reserve and one heavy validation. Off features start no hidden services.
contract.discovery: Unmapped or partially implemented behaviors create mandatory child tasks with source evidence and concrete tests. Parent acceptance waits for all children. No silent exclusions or retrospective acceptance receipts.
contract.externalAuthority: Missing authorized provider access, account consent, Cloudflare credentials, signing identity, OS sandbox or physical devices is blocked, not passed. Do not invent credentials or increase provider budget.
